Name: I Can't Believe It's Not Butter (Exclamation Mark)
Author: chocolatte12
Description:
Do you have a ton of mods that add butter? Do you wish you had less butters? Then this mod isn't for you! Because it adds more butter.

Unlock the new Butter Churn at level 4 Farming! Add in any milk to make butter or oil to make margarine!

Buy the grilled cheese and fried butter recipes at the Saloon!

Two new buffs from butter and food!

Follow your dreams and make a butter sculpture! (Unlocked at level 4 Farming)

Clutter your inventory and recipes with even more butter!

Be better. Be butter.
